import json,re
from collections import Counter
P=json.load(open('pages.json'))
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s).strip()
rows=[]
for p in P:
    t=p['text']
    if not re.search(r'finds\s+the\s+following',t,re.I): continue
    resp=re.search(r'Respondent\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*\n\s*Other Party',t,re.S|re.I)
    if not resp: resp=re.search(r'Respondent\s*:\s*(.*?)\n',t,re.I)
    case=re.search(r'Case\s*Number\s*:\s*(\S+)',t,re.I)
    fv=re.search(r'finds\s+the\s+following\s+violation\(?s?\)?\s*:?(.*?)(?:recommends|Advisory Committee recommends)',t,re.S|re.I)
    pen=re.search(r'recommends\s+the\s+following\s+civil\s+penalty\s*:?(.*?)(?:Abstention|Additional Information|APPROVED|$)',t,re.S|re.I)
    rows.append(dict(file=p['file'],page=p['page'],year=p['year'],
        resp=norm(resp.group(1)) if resp else None,
        case=case.group(1) if case else None,
        vio=norm(fv.group(1)) if fv else None,
        pen=norm(pen.group(1)) if pen else None))
json.dump(rows,open('rows.json','w'))
print(len(rows))
print('no resp',sum(r['resp'] is None for r in rows),'no case',sum(r['case'] is None for r in rows),'no vio',sum(r['vio'] is None for r in rows),'no pen',sum(r['pen'] is None for r in rows))

print(Counter(r['vio'][:60] for r in rows if not re.match(r'^IC\s*8-1-26-\S+$',r['vio'] or '')).most_common(30))
